Set restrictions for production builds

Source: R/yml-restrictions.R
yml-restrictions.Rd

Configure which branches may build and how projr checks Git and archive versions before a production build. Omit a setting or pass NULL to leave its current value in place.

Usage

projr_yml_restrictions_set(
  branch = NULL,
  not_behind = NULL,
  profile = "default",
  not_behind_git = NULL,
  not_behind_remote = NULL,
  rule = NULL
)

Arguments

branch

TRUE allows any branch (default), a character vector allows the named branches, and FALSE prevents production builds on any branch.

not_behind

Earlier spelling of not_behind_git.

profile

Name of the profile to update. The default is "default".

not_behind_git

Whether to check if the local branch is behind its Git upstream. Defaults to TRUE.

not_behind_remote

Which archives to check. TRUE (default) checks the destinations selected for publication by this build. FALSE skips archive version checks. To check specific destinations, supply a character vector of archive titles or a named list such as list(github = "reports", local = "backup"). Include the type when a title applies to more than one archive. Selected archives are checked even when the build will not publish to them.

rule

Which project version must be at least as recent as each selected archive's completed version. "base_version_not_behind" (or "base", the default) compares the version before the bump. "target_version_not_behind" (or "target") compares the version the build will create.

Value

Invisibly returns TRUE.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
projr_yml_restrictions_set(branch = c("main", "dev"))
projr_yml_restrictions_set(not_behind_git = FALSE)
projr_yml_restrictions_set(
  not_behind_remote = list(github = "reports", local = "backup"),
  rule = "target"
)
} # }
